Claim 2: E03 compares ts_online against the label-free agreement threshold at an equal 25% budget (545 groups). The threshold has no free labels. D = -0.172, CI [-0.230, -0.142], which favors the fixed rule. L5a and L5c repeat this for the shipped LearnedAllocator (D -0.454 and -0.472). Claim 3: E10 uses a different model (OLMo-2 1B) and reports an AUC gain of -0.002 and a cell100 neighbor ratio of 0.998. E04 and L7b use different proxies, with gains of 0.0001 and -0.006 and ratios of 1.00. All of these are below the kill thresholds. W2 is false because the free-label confound was controlled by the label-free baseline in E03. W3 is false because the ledger concludes claim 3 is killed, not supported.
